Hygiene checkpoint for lane `ajcr-p2` (run 0088) in the Archon Horizon workspace at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon. Scope your changes narrowly to what THIS lane touched; nine other lanes are live on the same shared ledger index, so stage explicit paths only and never `git add -A` or a directory-scoped add (see inbox I-1041 — a directory add staged another lane's file for deletion; and I-0999 — `git read-tree HEAD` silently reverts unstaged work).

WHAT THIS LANE DID, so you can check it rather than rediscover it:
- Claimed roadmap row `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-b`, then released it (owner cleared, status pending). Verify at HEAD with `git --git-dir /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git --work-tree /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon show HEAD:.archon-horizon/roadmap/items/AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-b.yaml` — I expect `status: pending` and no owner. If another lane's sweep reverted it, restore it and say so.
- Landed two Lean modules: `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageAffineTest.lean` and `.../Pic0ChartCoverageSlice.lean`, both rooted in `AlgebraicJacobian.lean`. Commits `8ef1105ff`, `22d4cf035`, `e7f140babb`, `05c61d6258`.
- Posted inbox items I-0963 (claim), I-1036 (issue), I-1037 (release).

TASKS, in priority order:

1. **Stray probe files.** Inbox I-1004 reports the AJCR hgraph has 108 nodes over files the build never sees, 104 marked `lean_ok`, including throwaway `controlSorry` probes from four prover lanes that `graph frontier` then surfaces as real work. I created and deleted scratch dirs `scratch_p2/`, `scratch_p2b/`, and a subagent created `scratch_p2probe/`. Confirm none of those directories exist on disk and none is tracked at HEAD (`git ls-tree`). If any of MY scratch probes (`controlSorryP2`, `controlSorrySliceP2`, `controlSorrySlice`, `controlSorryAbsorb`, `datum_from_slice`, `datum_of_class_eq_in_slice`, and anything under a `scratch_p2*` path) leaked into the hgraph node set or into the ledger, remove those nodes/files. Do NOT touch other lanes' probe nodes — report them instead; I-1004 is already filed.

2. **Roadmap consistency for what I touched.** Check `dat-b` and its parents for status/owner coherence. Inbox I-0971 says the `dat-j` "every sub-item is done" warning is intentional and must NOT be closed — leave it. Report any warning that remains and why you left it.

3. **Inbox hygiene, narrowly.** The open non-protection set is ~310 items against a recommended 30, which is far beyond this lane's remit — do NOT attempt a general sweep. Only: archive or complete items that MY work actually resolved, and check whether I-0963 (my claim announcement) is now stale given I-1037 (my release) supersedes it. Never archive a standing protection.

4. **Report, do not guess.** For each action: what you changed, the explicit path, and the commit sha if you committed. For anything you found but deliberately left alone, one line saying why. If a commit attempt trips the deletion guard, do NOT run `read-tree`; stage your own paths first and retry, and tell me if you could not commit.
